units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 48b:7">B. Mets. 48ᵇ</cite> <he>הנותן ע׳ … עֵרְבוֹנִי מחול לך והלה … אכפול לך עֵרְבוֹנְךָ</he> if a man gives an earnest to his neighbor and says, if I retract, my earnest shall be forfeit to thee; and the neighbor says, if I retract, I shall double thy earnest to thee; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 1:17">Tosef. ib. I, 17</cite>, sq.

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 7:20">Esth. R. to III, 10</cite> <he>מנהגו של עולם דרכו של לוקח ליתן ע׳ וכ׳</he> ordinarily it is the purchaser that gives an earnest to the seller, but here the seller (Ahasuerus) gives a pledge (his ring); <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 7:12">Ruth R. to IV, 8</cite>.

<cite ref="Pesachim 118b:4">Pes. 118ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Judges 5:21">Jud. V, 21</cite>) <he>אמר הקב״ה … צא והשלם ערבונך</he> the Lord said to the brook Kishon, go and surrender thy pledge (Sisera’s men bathing in the brook).
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:16">Ab. III, 16</cite> <he>הכל נתון בע׳</he> every thing is given against a pledge, i.e. life and possession are a loan for which you are pledged to the Lord; a. fr.

<cite ref="Yevamot 109a:17">Yeb. 109ᵃ</cite> <he>ויתרחק … ומן הע׳</he> (Rashi <cite ref="P01272"><he>ערבון</he></cite>) and should keep aloof from cases of protest (v. <cite ref="M01077"><he>מִיאוּן</he></cite>), from trusts, and from going security (<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 93">Gen. R. s. 93</cite>, beg. <he>מלעשות ערבות וכ׳</he>).
